fusions.name: Burst Sandbag
fusions.desc: Hurls a sack of jagged rubble that bursts on the first enemy it meets for 30 damage, and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Braided Sling
fusions.desc: Slings a jagged stone from a braided sling at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 7 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at full reach. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Burlap Rampart
fusions.desc: Stacks a 5-tile wall of sandbags ahead of you that nothing crosses for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Ballast Lining
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10% and your earth resistance by 8%.
